title: Study Platform ArcHIV - a multicentre, non-interventional, observational study evaluating the care of HIV patients and the clinical course of HIV infection in patients in Germany
summary:
This study is a longitudinal observational study of HIV-positive patients from different HIV-focus practices in Germany with the aim to generate a database of a correspondingly large patient collective and to describe the medical care of HIV patients and the clinical course of HIV infection in Germany, as well as to answer questions concerning their clinical care.
The study will run for several years. Only the data from clinical care are collected.  
The central evaluation agency MUC Research creates the electronic database with a documentation form (resp. interface to the electronic patient record) and center-specific access rights in order to collect the data in a structured manner and facilitate evaluation. 
A data protection concept is available.
conditions: Data of care from HIV-positive patients in Germany

interventions.name:
HIV-infected patients are asked to provide their consent for the creation of a supra-regional database in order to be able to carry out an evaluation of both the course of HIV infection and care-relevant data over a longer period of time than is usually the case in clinical trials.
For this purpose

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
>18 years, 
secured HIV infection, 
existence of the signed patient consent and data protection declaration
Exclusion criteria:
Patients without HIV-infection, Age <18 years, patients without consent
